title: Telemetry snapshot service and lightweight observability contract for analytics pipelines
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: the analytics ingest pipeline is generating high cardinality metrics and full traces for most requests which drives retention cost and makes on-call debugging slow. This ticket scopes a lightweight Telemetry Snapshot Service (TSS) that periodically captures low-cardinality per-request summaries plus a small number of contextual trace anchors. TSS will provide: 1) compact SLI inputs (p95/p99 latency, error counts, ingestion queue depth) sampled at tenant and route level, 2) trace anchors (trace IDs + limited breadcrumb) for targeted cold-start investigations, 3) a contract for downstream analytics consumers describing fields, retention, and cost budget. Deliverables: design doc, proto/Avro schema, producer side SDK hooks, consumer compatibility tests, dashboards and runbooks, rollout plan with canary and backfill strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Observability and Analytics owners
Producer SDK implemented in ingest service with feature flag
TSS writes compact snapshots to kafka topic with schema validation
Consumer compatibility tests pass in staging and prod shadow mode
Dashboard tile showing snapshot-derived SLIs for top 50 tenants
Runbook and paging rules updated; cost delta projection validated
